Setup Verification & Baseline Quality Check

Passing-only reference test suite

Verify your capture setup, frame timing, and brightness calibration without exposure to flashing lights. Every test case in this suite has mathematically proven, ground-truth values that are guaranteed to PASS under WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.1.

100% Photosensitivity Safe No rapid or dangerous flashing Known mathematical reference values

Why use this suite?

Before testing unknown client websites or videos, run these reference inputs to confirm:

  • No false alarms: Clean animations must produce zero candidate alarms.
  • Accurate capture timing: Observed frame rate reaches 30+ frames/sec.
  • Precise contrast math: Calculated relative luminance (ΔY) matches known ground-truth values.
  • Display ratio fidelity: Viewport CSS and device pixel ratio (DPR) are tracked accurately.

1. Known passing image pairs (for Image Sequences tester)

Test these known pairs at Test Image Sequences to verify the image screening engine:

Pass Case 1: Sub-threshold frequency (2.0 Hz black/white)

PASS · Sub-threshold Speed

Alternates between pure black and pure white at 2 complete cycles per second (4 changes/s). While contrast is maximum (ΔY = 1.0), the speed is well below the WCAG 3-flash limit.

Image A (Black)RGB (0, 0, 0) · Relative Luminance Y = 0.00000
Image B (White)RGB (255, 255, 255) · Relative Luminance Y = 1.00000
Luminance Contrast (ΔY)1.00000
Toggle Speed4 changes/s = 2.0 complete flash cycles/sec
Expected Peak CountExactly 2 general pairs in any 1-second window
Expected Verdictinconclusive-no-candidates (PASS)

Pass Case 2: Exact boundary frequency (3.0 Hz black/white)

PASS · Boundary Baseline

Alternates between pure black and pure white at exactly 3 complete cycles per second (6 changes/s). WCAG SC 2.3.1 permits up to 3 flashes per second; only more than 3 is prohibited.

Image A (Black)RGB (0, 0, 0) · Relative Luminance Y = 0.00000
Image B (White)RGB (255, 255, 255) · Relative Luminance Y = 1.00000
Luminance Contrast (ΔY)1.00000
Toggle Speed6 changes/s = 3.0 complete flash cycles/sec
Expected Peak CountExactly 3 general pairs in any 1-second window
Expected Verdictinconclusive-no-candidates (PASS)

Pass Case 3: Low-contrast rapid toggle (10 Hz soft gray)

PASS · Low Contrast Exception

Alternates rapidly at 10 cycles/sec (20 changes/s), but between very close gray shades (#B0B0B0 and #B8B8B8). Because ΔY is below 0.10, human eyes do not experience a photosensitive flash.

Image A (#B0B0B0)RGB (176, 176, 176) · Relative Luminance Y = 0.43419
Image B (#B8B8B8)RGB (184, 184, 184) · Relative Luminance Y = 0.47895
Luminance Contrast (ΔY)0.04476 (Must be < 0.10000)
Toggle Speed20 changes/s = 10.0 cycles/sec
Expected Peak Count0 general pairs / 1s
Expected Verdictinconclusive-no-candidates (PASS)
